name: Nombrevilla (Spain)
description: Blue field with a red chevron edged yellow pointing to the fly bearing a white letter N, continued by a red stripe edged yellow bearing a white cross of Lorraine.
history: Municipal flag of Nombrevilla; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: chevron edged yellow issuing from the hoist and pointing to the fly
edges of the chevron and stripe
letter N on the chevron and cross of Lorraine on the stripe
